Package ecs_architecture.standard

Class GameSystem

  • java.lang.Object
    • ecs_architecture.standard.GameSystem
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    DrawAPI, GameplayAPI, KeyboardAPI, Launchable, Subroutine, StateChanger
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AnimationSystem, ClockSystem, EffectSystem, SpriteRenderSystem, TextSystem, TimerSystem
    public abstract class GameSystem
extends java.lang.Object
implements Launchable, GameplayAPI, StateChanger
    An abstract class to be extended by a game system
